blocks.text: Muse Spark Open
Muse Spark Open 是一个针对编码优化的开放权重模型。它专门针对智能体编码工作流进行训练，提供更高的首次尝试准确率、可靠的工具调用，以及对开发者实际使用的代码仓库的深度代码库理解。你可以在我们之前的模型发布博客中阅读更多内容 此处。

blocks.text: 智能体

Muse Spark Open 从一开始就作为智能体模型构建。它规划步骤、行动、观察，并在长时间跨度内自我纠正——而不仅仅是单次工具调用。它经过训练可以浏览网页（包括多模态浏览），并使用智能体框架来：为可分解的工作生成并协调子智能体；以及利用统一于桌面、移动端和浏览器的计算机使用能力。 它基于长时间跨度、多站点任务进行训练，并生成单独的评论，让模型在行动前说明意图——因此你始终可以知道它在做什么以及为什么。

blocks.text: 为什么使用 Helion 内核？

inlines.text: 为什么使用 Helion 内核？

blocks.text: Helion 是一种 PyTorch 原生的内核编写语言，专为跨异构硬件平台编写高性能内核而设计。在开源生态系统的早期采用之后，Helion 于 2026 年 4 月成为 PyTorch Foundation 的一部分。Muse Spark Open 随附了 RoPE、RMSNorm、量化等操作的 Helion 实现，在 NVIDIA GB300 上，相比用硬件特定语言（例如 NVIDIA CUDA 和 CuTe DSL）编写的自定义内核，实现了 1.03 – 3.95 倍的加速。这些相同的内核可直接移植到 AMD，在 AMD Mi350 上取得了类似的性能提升，端到端吞吐量整体提升了 3%。

blocks.text: 此外，我们还在 SGLang 中为 Muse Spark Open 推出了 Helion megakernels。这些内核完全用 Helion 编写，将多个操作融合到单个持久内核中，以改善低延迟推理，并且同样可以针对不同的形状和硬件进行自动调优。

blocks.text: 用户可进一步针对更广泛的硬件平台和工作负载对 Helion 内核进行自动调优——包括不同的加速器架构（NVIDIA、AMD、Google TPU 等）、量化格式、张量形状和并行策略——而无需为每种配置维护单独的手工调优实现。这些能力共同使实现可移植性能变得更加容易，同时降低了开发和维护专用内核的成本。

inlines.text: Muse Spark Is Now an Open-Weights Model

blocks.text: Today, Meta is releasing the weights for Muse Spark Open, the most capable US open-weights model to date. It’s available today on Hugging Face under the Muse Model License. Muse Spark Open runs optimized on the SGLang and vLLM inference engines, with optimization for NVIDIA, AMD, and Intel.

inlines.text: Today, Meta is releasing the weights for

, the most capable US open-weights model to date. It’s available today on Hugging Face under the Muse Model License. Muse Spark Open runs optimized on the SGLang and vLLM inference engines, with optimization for NVIDIA, AMD, and Intel.

blocks.text: Building on our August release of Muse Spark, this open weights version has additional safety post-training to make it more robust against misuse as a standalone model without system guardrails. The result is a model that is a top open source choice for safety. Muse Spark Open is an 816B total/42B active parameter model with a context window of 1M tokens. Built for coding and agentic work, Muse Spark Open is natively multimodal and shares the same base model as Muse Spark 1.3.

blocks.text: Meta loves open source, and as the creators of PyTorch, we’re committed to giving back to ensure the entire ecosystem fully supports Muse Spark Open. First, we’ve integrated Helion, our exciting new PyTorch-native high-level DSL for performant and portable ML kernels, to ship high-performance operations. Additionally, TorchTitan already supports Muse Spark out of the box for supervised fine-tuning and RL in the open, and we’re excited to see how far the PyTorch community can take it!

blocks.text: Multimodal Understanding
Muse Spark Open has audio and audio-video perception — alongside image and document understanding. As a reasoning model, it processes image, audio, and text inputs — natively and reliably.

blocks.text: Agentic

Muse Spark Open is built from the ground up as an agentic model. It maps out steps, acts, observes, and self-corrects over long horizons — not just single-shot tool calls. It’s trained to browse the web (including multimodal browsing), and use an agentic harness to: spawn and coordinate subagents for decomposable work; and leverage computer use capabilities unified across desktop, mobile, and browser. It’s trained on long-horizon, multi-site tasks, and generates separate commentary that lets the model state intent before acting—so you can always know what it’s doing and why.

blocks.text: Why Helion kernels?

Helion is a PyTorch native kernel authoring language designed for writing high-performance kernels across heterogeneous hardware platforms. Following early adoption from the open-source ecosystem, Helion became a part of the PyTorch Foundation in April 2026. Muse Spark Open ships with Helion implementations of operations such as RoPE, RMSNorm, quantization, etc., delivering 1.03 – 3.95x speedups compared to custom kernels written in hardware specific languages (e.g. NVIDIA CUDA and CuTe DSL) on NVIDIA GB300. These same kernels were directly portable for AMD, scoring similar performance improvements on AMD Mi350 with an overall 3% improvement in end-to-end throughput.

blocks.text: In addition, we also launched Helion megakernels for Muse Spark Open in SGLang. Written entirely in Helion, these kernels fuse multiple operations into a single persistent kernel to improve low latency inference, and can likewise be autotuned for different shapes and hardware.

blocks.text: Helion kernels can be further autotuned by users for broader hardware platforms and workloads – including different accelerator architectures (NVIDIA, AMD, Google TPU, etc.), quantization formats, tensor shapes, and parallelism strategies – without maintaining separate hand-tuned implementations for every configuration. Together, these capabilities make it easier to achieve portable performance while reducing the cost of developing and maintaining specialized kernels.

blocks.text: Post-training with TorchTitan

TorchTitan is a PyTorch native platform designed for rapid experimentation and large-scale training of generative AI models. Starting today, TorchTitan adds a model definition for Meta’s Muse Spark Open , so developers can tune it to their needs.
